default_model.description: Default model name for new sessions (points to a model in Config.models)

enable_subagent.description: Allow the agent to spawn sub-agents

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of iterations per agent run

max_tool_output_length.description: Maximum tool output length in bytes (default `40_000`)

name.description:
Agent identity name. Substituted into the `{{name}}` placeholder of
`system_prompt` when the config is finalized in `build_agent_config`.

system_prompt.description:
Custom system prompt override; supports the {{name}} placeholder.
The built-in default prompt is used when unset.

tool_blocklist.description: Tool blocklist (regex patterns) for disabling tools

ChannelConfig.description: One external platform channel instance (e.g. a Feishu app)

admin_users.description:
`open_id`s allowed to approve/deny doc-permission applications
(buttons and `/approve` `/deny` `/permits` commands alike). Also the
DM recipients when `approval_chat_id` is unset.

allowed_chats.description: Chat allowlist; empty = all chats allowed

allowed_users.description: User allowlist; empty = all users allowed

approval_chat_id.description:
Target group chat for doc-permission application notifications.
When unset, each of `admin_users` is notified by DM instead; when
both are unset the feature is off (applications are only logged).

auto_approve_level.description: Channel-level auto-approve override for tool permissions

disabled_events.description:
Runtime kill-switch for platform event features (the vocabulary is
per-platform, see [`PlatformConfig::known_event_names`]); unset =
all enabled. Event delivery itself requires console-side
subscription — this disables *reacting* without a console trip.

history_context.description:
Recent-chat messages injected as context when the bot is triggered
in a group (fetched since the last trigger in that thread/chat,
newest cap). 0 disables.

mid_run_split.description:
Mid-run split: when the user posts messages while a run is in
flight, freeze the status card in place as a terminal receipt and
deliver the final reply as a NEW message below them (carrying the
run trace). When disabled, the status card always morphs into the
final reply in place (one message per run), leaving the answer
above the user's mid-run messages.

observability.description:
Status card + run receipts for run observability. When disabled,
no status card or run receipts are shown; reply buffering (only the
last assistant text becomes the reply bubble) still applies.

reply_in_thread.description:
When enabled, group-chat replies are anchored to the triggering
message so they land in its thread (Feishu thread reply, Telegram
quote-reply). Private chats are unaffected.

require_mention.description: In group chats, require @mention to trigger the bot

tool_trace.description:
Attach the run trace (tool calls + intermediate texts) to the final
reply bubble — a collapsible panel on card-capable platforms
(Feishu, requires client V7.9+), plain-text lines elsewhere.

keep_recent_messages.description: Number of recent messages to preserve during full compaction

keep_recent_tool_results.description: Number of recent messages whose tool results survive micro-compaction

threshold_ratio.description: Ratio (0.0–1.0) of the context window at which compaction is triggered

ExtensionConfig.description: `[[extensions]]` 条目：列出即拉起，daemon 死则组杀，崩溃固定退避重拉。

command.description: 命令行（argv[0] 为可执行文件）。

all.description: Enable all features unless a feature is explicitly overridden.

attachments.description:
Teach agents the `<yomi_attachments>` syntax for attaching files to
replies (channels deliver the files, the app shows clickable items).
Unlike the experimental flags above this is **on by default** and
ignores `all`; set `false` to disable. Attachments already declared
in history still surface when disabled — the flag only gates what
agents are taught.

cron_tool.description: Expose the cron tool to agents (create/list/update/delete/trigger jobs).

todo_tool.description: Expose the todo tool to agents (task list tracking).

update_session_title.description: Generate a session title with a model after receiving a user message.

GcConfig.description:
Garbage-collection policy for expired session resources (`[gc]` section).

These are *policy* settings: what to collect and, for the daemon, how
often. Whether a run actually deletes (`dry_run`) is a per-invocation
flag and deliberately not configurable here.

auto.description:
Run gc automatically in the daemon (opt-in; performs real deletions).
Runs once at startup and then every day at local midnight.

retention_days.description:
Sessions are retained for this many days after their last update
before gc collects them (min 1)

sweep_orphans.description: Sweep orphan files whose session no longer exists in the DB

Level.description:
工具危险级别 / 自动批准阈值

用于表示：
- 工具的固有危险级别（Tool Level）
- 用户配置的自动批准阈值（Auto-approve Threshold）

oneOf.description: 可修改，但可撤销的操作（如编辑文件）
破坏性、不可撤销或影响外部的操作

context_window.description: 该模型对应的上下文窗口大小

endpoint.description: API base URL of the provider

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with every request

model_id.description: Model identifier sent to the provider API

sse_timeout_secs.description: SSE stream read timeout in seconds

oneOf.description: `OpenAI` Responses API (`/v1/responses`), for GPT-5 / o-series reasoning models

PlatformConfig.description: Platform adapter credentials; the variant is selected by the `type` tag

fast_model.description: Model key used for lightweight tasks. Falls back to the session model when absent.

effort.description:
Reasoning effort / output quality level (low/medium/high)
Used for `OpenAI` `reasoning_effort` and `Anthropic` `output_config.effort`

auto_approve.description: Default auto-approve level for tool permissions (safe | caution | dangerous)

data_dir.description: Data directory for sessions, logs, databases, etc. (default `~/.yomi`)

env.description:
General-purpose environment variables injected at startup, overriding
host values.
Keys are used verbatim and do not require the [`crate::ENV_PREFIX`] prefix.

extensions.description: wire 外部扩展（TOML: `[[extensions]]`）：跟随 daemon 拉起的扩展进程。

gc.description: Garbage-collection policy for expired session resources

max_checkpoints.description: Maximum number of checkpoints to retain per session (default: 5)

models.description: Multi-model configuration array (TOML: `[[models]]`), at least one element

skill_folders.description: Skill 目录列表，按优先级从低到高排列（同名 skill 由靠后的目录胜出）。

socket_auth_hash.description:
Socket auth password hash (`blake3:<hex>`), enforced on ws/wss
transports only; unix sockets rely on filesystem permissions.
`YOMI_SOCKET_AUTH_HASH` overrides. None = no auth.
